Ngi shong ha ka pyrthei ka ba-itynnat. Don 
sa kiwei pat ki met-bneng klba marjan ia kane 
ka khyndew ba ngi shong ma-ngi. Ka sngi, u 
Bnai bad ki Khlur ki long ki sharak kiba pyn-

mynsngi mynsngi, u Bnai bad ki Khlur pat ki 
pynshai mynmiet mynmiel. Kine ki sharak sa- 
hit-bneng, ki long ki bathaba bad ki baitynnat 
haduh katta katta. Ki long kum ki mawlynnai 
ha ka suin-bneng. 

Ha kane ka pyrthei-khyndew ba ngi shong 
mangi, don ki lum bajyrngam bad ki them 
baiar. Ki dieng bad ki syntiew har rukom ki 
taplup ia kine ki lum bad ia kine ki them. Ki 
syntiew ba-bun rong ki pynsuhsleng ia ka Iyer 
da ka jingiwbih jong ki. Bad ki dieng ki sei ki 
soh lalphewjait, ki babang bad ki bathiang. 

Don ki sim bun jait bad bun rong. Ki sim 
ki long ki nongrwai bad nongsiaw bastad. Ki 
nang bun ki sur basngewthiang.
